note: Due-diligence checklists as data. Questions to ask and documents to see; guidance only. Policy figures live in policy-tables.json.

common_property.check: Search the title: freehold, 999-year, or 99-year with start date; encumbrances, caveats, and mortgages to be discharged.
Confirm the registered owner's identity and authority to sell; tenancy in place; reason for sale.
Compare asking with recent transactions using the existing --mode hdb/private/ec before offering; get the bank/HDB valuation and plan cash for any gap.
Floor, facing, view, noise, ventilation, layout efficiency, water seepage, renovation quality and permits.
Flood-prone areas, dengue clusters, air quality, noise sources, upcoming URA developments (ura_context).

common_financial.check: Stress-tested TDSR (and MSR where it applies) passes with margin; run plan mode with low/base/high interest scenarios.

common_financial.item: Cash and CPF at each stage
common_financial.check: Know the minimum cash and CPF needed at option, exercise, stamp duty, legal fees and completion.
In-principle approval or HDB Flat Eligibility letter before exercising the option.
Emergency fund and renovation budget remain after completion.
Seller's stamp duty exposure if sold early; CPF refund with accrued interest on sale.

new_launch_condo.check: Past completed projects, on-time TOP delivery, defects handling, financial standing.
Expected TOP and CSC dates in the S&P; compensation for late vacant possession; progressive payment schedule.
Compare show-flat finishes and facilities with the written specifications; check the unit's stack, view and layout in the plans.
Land tenure, unit count, unit-mix, nearby supply and unsold units; use --mode investment for the supply signal.
Stamp duties, legal fees, interest during construction, maintenance fees once TOP is issued.

resale_condo.check: Years left on a 99-year lease; bank loan and CPF limits may tighten for shorter leases; freehold vs leasehold pricing gap.
Monthly maintenance, sinking fund balance, planned major works, special levies, arrears.
Facilities condition, lift upgrades, past defects, en-bloc history and rumours.
Share of small units and rented units; owner-occupier ratio; unit size vs price per sq ft.
Option fee, exercise period, completion date, and fixtures included in the sale.

resale_hdb.check: Remaining lease against the youngest buyer's age 95 coverage; CPF usage and HDB loan pro-rating; EHG minimum lease.
HDB/bank valuation vs agreed price; cash-over-valuation payable in cash.
HDB Flat Eligibility letter, income ceilings, first-timer status, citizenship, ethnic quota and any cooling-off.
Seller has completed the MOP; any resale levy or conditions attached; 3Gen resale restrictions.
Upgrading status (lifts, HIP), floor, facing, noise, nearby construction and conservancy charges.

ec.check: Household income vs the EC ceiling at purchase; first-timer or second-timer status.
Occupation period, restrictions on selling to non-eligible buyers, privatisation timeline.
MSR applies during the MOP; progressive payments and developer track record as for a new launch.
Developer, TOP date, nearby supply and amenities.
